name: input-16
description: Card number, expiry, and CVC inputs that auto-format as the user types.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CreditCardIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { Input } from "@workspace/ui/components/input" import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput, } from "@workspace/ui/components/input-group" function formatCard(v: string) { return v .replace(/\D/g, "") .slice(0, 16) .replace(/(.{4})/g, "$1 ") .trim() } function formatExpiry(v: string) { const d = v.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4) return d.length > 2 ? d.slice(0, 2) + "/" + d.slice(2) : d } export default function CardPaymentInputs() { const [card, setCard] = React.useState("4242 4242 4242 4242") const [expiry, setExpiry] = React.useState("") return (
Card number setCard(formatCard(e.target.value))} className="font-mono" />
Expiry setExpiry(formatExpiry(e.target.value))} /> CVC
) }
